definition: to lose one's colours, brightness, lustre; to become colourless, dim.
example_en: The old cloth lost its colour in the sun and turned pale.

definition: to stay at a place (temporarily); to sojourn.
example_en: The traders sojourned outside the village.

definition: to become more in number, quantity, size, value, etc.; to grow great, abundant.
example_en: The river's water grew abundant due to the flood.

definition: nearness; proximity.
example_en: There was a temple in the proximity of the village.

definition: a dirty, filthy person.
example_en: That filthy person never used to bathe.

definition: (gen.) a blossom of a plant; a flower.
example_en: A flower blossomed on the branch of the plant.

definition: the tree Ziziphus mauritiana ( = Z. jujuba) of Rhamnaceae family; jujube.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿಯ ಮನೆಯ ಅಂಗಳದಲ್ಲಿ ವೃತ್ತಫಲ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: A jujube tree has grown in grandmother's courtyard.

definition: an indecent, unmannerly gesture or gestures.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಶಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಪಿಚೇಷ್ಟೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರನ್ನು ಕೋಪಗೊಳಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The children made indecent gestures at school and angered the teacher.

definition: a small portion separated from a whole; a piece.
example: ಒಡೆದ ಬಟ್ಟಲಿನ ಶಕಳ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A piece of the broken bowl fell on the ground.

definition: the state or quality of being stable or fixed; stability; steadiness; firmness.
example: ಆ ಗೋಡೆಯ ನಿಚ್ಚಟಿಕೆ ಕಟ್ಟಡಕ್ಕೆ ಭದ್ರತೆ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The firmness of that wall gave stability to the building.

definition: the rate charged for something when sold in retail (which is, usu. more than the wholesale rate).
example_en: In this shop the retail rate is a little higher.

definition: to turn one's face downward (from shame, shyness or modesty).
example_en: The child who had erred bowed its head in shame.

definition: to become greater in size, number, intensity, etc.
example_en: The suffering of the famine grew greater in that village.

definition: fresh butter got by churning curds.
example_en: Mother churned the curds and took out fresh butter.

definition: soothing words; polite or courteous speech.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಅನುನಯವಚನ ಕೇಳಿ ಶಿಷ್ಯನ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಶಾಂತವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the teacher's soothing words, the disciple's mind became calm.

definition: the act of scattering here and there.
example_en: The children scattered their toys here and there.

definition: measurements in length, width, and height or depth; dimensions.
example_en: The engineer measured the dimensions of the building.

definition: the hemispherical or conical structure, with or without covered by a metal plate, on the top of the sanctum sanctorum of a temple.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಿನ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಗುಡಿಮೊನೆ ಚಿನ್ನದ ತಗಡಿನಿಂದ ಹೊಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The dome on the temple on the hill shines with a gold plate.

definition: an enjoyer of something.
example_en: The true enjoyer of happiness is one with a contented mind.

definition: a man whose occupation is to cut and dress the hair; a barber.
example_en: The barber cut his hair nicely.

definition: leavings in a dining plate.
example_en: Do not get up and leave the leavings on the plate.

definition: moderately cold; cool.
example_en: The morning breeze was very cool.

definition: a kind of poetical conversation, in the form of a song, sung by a group of persons hailing the excellence of men over women (as a sport).
example: ಗಂಡಸರು ಹರದೇಶಿ ಹಾಡಿ ತಮ್ಮ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊಗಳಿದರು.
example_en: The men sang the haradeshi song and praised their own superiority.

definition: an object burning at a very high temperature.
example_en: On that battlefield, fire burned like an intensely hot blaze.

definition: a place where tiffin, meals, beverages, etc. can be bought and eaten; a restaurant.
example_en: We had a meal at the restaurant.

definition: the smallest of the five digits of the human hand; the small finger.
example_en: There was a ring on his little finger.

definition: a long petal (of a flower).
example_en: The long petal of that flower is very long.

definition: a kind of grass.
example_en: A kind of grass had grown on the field bund.

definition: a kind of medical substance.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಔಷಧಿಗೆ ಹಿರಭಿ ಎಂಬ ವಸ್ತು ಬೆರೆಸಿದರು.
example_en: The physicians mixed a substance called hirabhi into the medicine.

definition: lack of similarity; the fact of being different; difference.
example_en: A difference was found between the two doctrines.

definition: to show a sign; to express by a sign; to give a clue or hint.
example_en: The hunter showed the sign from the animal's footprints.

definition: a comprehensive, all-inclusive view.
example: ಈ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪೂರ್ಣದೃಷ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This book gives a comprehensive view of the subject.

definition: designating or having a sharp, often unpleasant taste; bitter.
example_en: The taste of this medicine is bitter.

definition: a game of chance, played with stakes.
example_en: A group was engrossed in the game of chance at night.

definition: a continuous rain.
example_en: Continuous rain falls during the monsoon.

definition: the plant Mucuna prurita (= M. Puriens) of Papilionaceae family; cat bean plant.
example_en: The farmers grew the kadakare vine along the fence.

definition: a man employed in a palace, whose duty is to sing auspicious songs, and to proclaim the titles of a king at dawn.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಜಾವ ವೈತಾಲಿಕ ರಾಜನ ಬಿರುದುಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾರಿ ಹಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: At dawn the vaitalika proclaimed the king's titles and sang.

definition: very bad reputation; notoriety; disgrace; dishonour; infamy.
example_en: That incident brought great disgrace to the family.

definition: a man whose work is building with brick, concrete, etc.; a mason.
example_en: The mason built the wall with bricks.

definition: a continuing and bitter hatred or ill will; deep spite or malice; hostility; enmity.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ವಿವಾದದಿಂದಾಗಿ ಅವರ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಡಾವು ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: Because of the old dispute, deep spite grew in their minds.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The honnāri plant had spread on the slope of the hill.

definition: (fig.) sexually immoral, unrestrained behaviour.
example_en: The villagers were disgusted by his sexually loose behaviour.

definition: (said of horned animals) a striking or butting with the horns.
example: ಎರಡು ಎತ್ತುಗಳ ಕೋಡಾಟವನ್ನು ಜನ ನೋಡುತ್ತಾ ನಿಂತರು.
example_en: The people stood watching the butting of horns between the two bullocks.

definition: a hump-backed woman.
example_en: The hump-backed woman walked carrying the child.

definition: one who gives or writes answers.
example_en: The one who answers the question stood up in the meeting.

definition: wet, soft earth or earthy matter, as on the ground after rain, at the bottom of a pond or along the banks of a river; mire; mud.
example_en: After the rain, the whole path was full of mud.

definition: a kind duty charged by the government.
example_en: The traders had to pay the external duty at the border.

definition: brightness; radiance; brilliance; lustre.
example_en: The lustre of that gem was dazzling to the eyes.

definition: the number of vibrations, cycles or recurrences in a unit or given time; frequency.
example_en: This sound wave's frequency is high.

definition: to employ, keep a person as a slave.
example_en: That rich man kept the poor boy as a slave.

definition: (vīr.) the subtle body.
example_en: Veerashaivas reflect deeply on the subtle body.

definition: a serious disease, associated with streptococcal infections, typically occuring in children, characterised by fever, swelling and pain in the joints, sore throat, and cardiac involvement; rheaumatic fever.
example_en: The child has rheumatic fever and pain in the joints.

definition: a man who is given to drinking of liquors.
example_en: The drunkard drank liquor every day.

definition: to cause to spit out or vomit.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಔಷಧ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ವಿಷವನ್ನು ಉಗುಚಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor gave him medicine and made him vomit out the poison.

definition: any of various lizards of Chamaeleontidae family with independently movable eyeballs, and have has the ability to change skin colour rapidly, and a long, agile tongue for catching prey; a chameleon.
example_en: The chameleon moves its eyes independently.

definition: a narrow opening or crack; fissure; a cleft.
example_en: A large crack appeared in the wall.

definition: to cause to form a pair; to match; to pair.
example_en: The cook matched the bowls according to color.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: People pluck the kottiya geḍḍe plant for medicine.

definition: of the first class quality; superior; supreme.
example_en: This is a first-class, superior cloth.

definition: the shrub Capparis decidua (= C. aphylla) of Capparaceae family; common caper.
example_en: Caper shrubs had grown in that open field.

definition: the plant Cicca acida ( = C. distictia) of Euphorbraceae family.
example_en: They use the leaves of the akkada plant for medicine.

definition: a wild animal; a beast.
example_en: A wild beast was hiding in the forest.

definition: the act, practice or quality of being hospitable; solicitous entertainment of guests.
example_en: Showing hospitality to guests is a tradition.

definition: a multitude of stars; a cluster of stars.
example_en: The cluster of stars looked beautiful in the sky.

definition: made sharp; sharpened.
example_en: The blacksmith made the knife sharp.

definition: produce, income, etc. got more than usual or expected.
example_en: This year the surplus produce of the crop was more.

definition: the basic, real, and invariable nature of a thing or its significant individual feature or features; essence; substance.
example_en: The essence of his words became clear to the people.

definition: a pond or lake.
example: ಊರ ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಸರವರ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a beautiful lake outside the village.

definition: the fleshy lower end of the human ear; lobe.
example_en: The baby's earlobe was soft.

definition: a sliding box in a table, bureau, chest, etc., that can be drawn out and then pushed back into place; a drawer.
example_en: There are pens in the drawer of the table.

definition: the act of painting, decorating with a paint or paints.
example_en: They got the house door freshly painted.

definition: a bag, sack, pouch or pocket.
example_en: She kept money in the pouch.

definition: a talking too rapidly.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಗಾಬರಿಯಿಂದ ಪಟಾಪಟಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಲು ಶುರುಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The girl started talking too rapidly out of nervousness.

definition: an image of a god, used as an object or instrument of worship; an idol.
example_en: The devotees worshipped the idol in the temple.

definition: an interjection used to point out an object which is relatively near.
example_en: Look here, look at the flower.

definition: deprived of the original meaning or importance.
example_en: That word is now used in a diminished sense, deprived of its original meaning.

definition: to bear or put up with; to tolerate.
example: ಆಕೆ ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಕಷ್ಟ ಬಂದರೂ ಸಯಿಸಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: However much hardship came, she tolerated it and kept working.

definition: a man lacking courage in facing danger, difficulty, opposition, etc.; a coward.
example_en: The coward ran away from the battle.

definition: to measure by the hand with the thumb and little finger extended; to span.
example_en: The grandfather spanned the cloth with his hand and measured it.

definition: to have or maintain enmity; to be hostile.
example_en: They had been hostile to each other for many years.

definition: truth; fact; reality; actuality.
example_en: There was no truth in his words.

definition: the act of conversion of a solid or liquid thing into gaseous state.
example_en: The conversion of water into gaseous state takes place in this machine.

definition: a man in whom blood is being discharged with blood, a characteristic of a particular disease.
example_en: The doctors examined the patient who was discharging blood in his urine.

definition: the act of bending or dangling from one side anoher repeatedly.
example: ಆಕೆಯ ನಡಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಮೃದುವಾದ ಬಳುಕು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a soft swaying motion in her walk.

definition: matted hair.
example_en: The ascetic's matted hair hung down to his shoulders.

definition: a prominent place.
example_en: That temple is located in a prominent place of the village.

definition: the fact or an instance of reducing a person to a lower rank, position; demotion.
example_en: After the defeat, he was given a demotion.

definition: a neighbouring house.
example: ಪಕ್ಕೆಮನೆಯ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ನಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆ ಆಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The children of the neighbouring house play with us every day.

definition: to cheque, test, examine or search thoroughly.
example_en: The police thoroughly searched that house.

definition: a developing or being developed.
example_en: Everyone must work hard for the development of the country.

definition: a man skilled in the operations of boats or ships.
example_en: The boatman steered the boat safely to the shore.

definition: (dial.) a long, narrow cleft or crack; a fissure.
example: ಆ ಬಂಡೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಉದ್ದದ ಚೀರಲ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: A long narrow fissure is visible in that rock.

definition: a kind of flowering plant.
example_en: Kalika plants have been planted in rows in the garden.

definition: the pollution caused by touching boiled rice or other cooked food or the vessels in which they are cooked or kept (before being washed).
example: ಎಂಜಲು ತಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ಮುಸರೆ ಮುಟ್ಟಿತೆಂದು ಅವಳು ಅದನ್ನು ತೊಳೆಯಲಿಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: Since the plate had touched the pollution of leftover food, she set it aside to be washed.

definition: the main stem of a plant.
example_en: The main stem of the plant had grown sturdy.

definition: the outer covering of onion, garlic, pulses, etc.
example_en: She peeled off the outer covering of the onion.

definition: abundance, plentifulness that is striking to the eyes.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾನ್ಯದ ದೆಖ್ಖಾಣ ಕಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The striking abundance of grain in that house was visible to the eye.

definition: a person having had much experience, as in a particular occupation or activity.
example_en: He is an experienced person in this field.

definition: a cannon-cracker used on festive occasions.
example_en: On the festival day, the children burst cannon-crackers.

definition: a kind of vermicelli made of wheat.
example_en: The wheat vermicelli was delicious for breakfast.

definition: priorly; previously.
example_en: This had been said priorly/previously.

definition: the fret of a vīṇe, a stringed musical instrument.
example_en: He adjusted the fret of the veena and played it.

definition: something that portends an unfortunate event before it happens; an ill omen; portent.
example_en: The dog howling in the morning was an ill omen for him.

definition: a group of individuals, most of whom are the same approximate age, having similar ideas, problems, attitudes, etc.; a generation.
example: ಈ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯ ಒಂದು ತಲೆಮಾರಿನಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This tradition continues from one generation to the next.

definition: a fine, mist-like rain.
example_en: A fine, mist-like rain fell in the early morning.

definition: the layer of skin just below the epidermis; dermis.
example_en: The wound was deep, reaching up to the dermis.

definition: done; performed; completed; worked.
example_en: This work has already been done.

definition: going from place to place; wandering; touring.
example_en: That sage lived wandering from place to place.

definition: a small part of a whole.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸ ಇಡೀ ಯೋಜನೆಯ ಒಂದು ಕಲೆ ಮಾತ್ರ.
example_en: This task is only a small part of the whole project.

definition: any of the heavenly bodies, except the moon, appearing as fixed luminous points in the sky at night; a star.
example_en: The stars were twinkling in the night sky.

definition: a man who has accomplished supernatural powers with the help of hymns.
example: ಆ ಮಂತ್ರಗಾರ ಮಂತ್ರಗಳಿಂದ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಶಕ್ತಿ ಪಡೆದಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That sorcerer had gained wondrous power through hymns.

definition: communication by electronic or electric means, as through radio, telephone, telegraph, television or computers; telecommunication.
example: ಈ ಚಿತ್ರೋತ್ಸವವು ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಕಂಪನಿಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಜಿತವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This film festival is sponsored by a famous company.

definition: to become abundant, superfluous.
example_en: The fruits became abundant and fell in the orchard.

definition: a large mass of stone; a rock.
example_en: There was a huge rock at the top of the hill.

definition: to save (from danger, death, etc.); to protect.
example_en: The doctor saved the patient from death.

definition: to take place; to happen; to occur.
example_en: That incident happened suddenly.

definition: to have a rebirth.
example_en: That soul had a rebirth again.

definition: a narrow inlet or arm of a river or the sea; estuary; firth.
example_en: Boats stood in a row in that narrow estuary.

definition: to put into the words of a different language; to translate.
example_en: I tried to translate that poem into Kannada.

definition: one of the eighteen important Purāṇas.
example_en: Grandfather used to recite the Vishnu Purana every day.

definition: (dial.) the quality of being grand, splendour; magnificence; grandeur.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಒಡ್ಡಾರವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone was amazed to see the grandeur of that house.

definition: a kind of venereal disease.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಆ ರೋಗಿಗೆ ದ್ವಂದ್ವಮೇಹ ಇರುವುದಾಗಿ ಪತ್ತೆ ಹಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor diagnosed that patient with a venereal disease.

definition: the cardinal number seventy; 70.
example_en: He got seventy marks in the exam.

definition: a cluster, a bunch, a collection of hairs, threads, feathers, flowers, grass etc. held or fastened together at one end.
example_en: She tightly tied the cluster of hair.

definition: to pay the penalty as a punishment for an offence.
example_en: Having erred, he had to pay the penalty to the court.

definition: the tree Sesbania paludosa of Papilonaceae family.
example_en: The sesbania trees stand on the bank of the lake.

definition: a stone piece or anything thrown by a catapult.
example_en: The stone thrown by the catapult hit his leg.

definition: the tendency (of a girl or woman) of making flirtous movement or manner for getting men's attention and admiration.
example_en: The men noticed her flirtatious manner.

definition: a variety of mustard plant.
example_en: The farmer grew that variety of mustard in the field.

definition: a person with a light-coloured skin; member of the Caucasoid division of humans, esp. an European.
example_en: Many light-skinned Europeans disembarked at the port.

definition: a glowing piece of coal; ember.
example_en: The glowing ember was still burning red in the kitchen.

definition: a taking of fruits only for food.
example_en: They prepared the fruit-only meal for the fast.

definition: (two or more heterogenous things) to mingle together, intermix; to commingle.
example: ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ಬಣ್ಣಗಳ ನೀರು ಸಂಕರಗೊಂಡು ಒಂದೇ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: The waters of different colours mingled together and became one.

definition: great splendour.
example_en: People were amazed to see the great splendour of the palace.

definition: to give sight to; to enable to see.
example_en: The doctor's surgery gave him back his sight.

definition: a multitude; a throng; a crowd.
example_en: The crowd of people at the fair was packed.

definition: the plant Capsicum annum of Solanaceae family; red pepper plant.
example_en: They were drying and selling red pepper at the shop.

definition: to declare (a statement) untrue; contradict; to deny.
example_en: The accused denied his own earlier statement.

definition: the frontage of a house.
example_en: The frontage of that house was very beautiful.

definition: the quantity or number equal to almost half of a whole.
example_en: He gave almost half of the property to his younger brother.

definition: a strong rigid support.
example_en: That pillar is a strong support for the roof.

definition: very high temperature; superheat.
example_en: In the intense heat of summer people sought shade.

definition: a person who cannot endure hunger.
example: ಆ ಅನ್ನಗತಪ್ರಾಣ ಒಂದು ದಿನವೂ ಉಪವಾಸ ಇರಲಾರ.
example_en: That person who cannot bear hunger cannot fast even for a day.

definition: curly hair of the head.
example_en: That girl had beautiful curly hair.

definition: holding a shield (as a soldier, policeman, etc.).
example_en: The soldier standing at the border was holding a shield.

definition: a dividing into groups of five.
example_en: The teacher taught the disciples the method of pancīkaraṇa, the dividing into groups of five.

definition: to be delighted.
example_en: He was delighted upon hearing the news.

definition: to divide (something) and distribute between or among.
example_en: The father divided the property and distributed it among the children.

definition: one's name, (or a representative and personalised sign or mark), usu. written by hand by oneself, as in subscribing a letter or other document.
example: ಅವನು ಪತ್ರದ ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನ ದಸಕತು ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: He wrote his signature at the end of the letter.

definition: an amorous play.
example_en: Their amorous play continued in the garden.

definition: the large-sized evergreen tree Calophyllum tomentosum of Guttiferae family.
example_en: The bobbe tree had grown tall in the forest.

definition: to tie anklets with jingling bells for dancing.
example_en: The dancer tied on her anklets with jingling bells and danced on the stage.

definition: a particular date (that is under disucssion or alrady refered to).
example_en: The particular date under discussion was mentioned again in the meeting.

definition: a par of two arms.
example_en: He stretched out his pair of arms and lifted the child.

definition: the act of opening one's eyes.
example_en: Everyone was startled by his opening of eyes.

definition: the training or labour involved in being trained in gymnastics.
example_en: Through the labour of gymnastic training his body became strong.

definition: the common, biting red-ant.
example_en: When the red ant bit my leg, it hurt a lot.

definition: the work or art of cutting wood and sculpting different shapes, idols, toys, etc.
example_en: He has great skill in wood-carving.

definition: to exert pressure esp. on all sides; to squeeze; to compress.
example_en: He squeezed the lump of clay with his hand.

definition: to fix solidly in place by driving a wedge or wedges under, beside, etc.
example_en: The carpenter fixed the pillar firmly with a wedge.

definition: (temperature, hotness) to rise.
example_en: By noon the heat of the sun had risen.

definition: a tender (human) body.
example_en: One must lift the baby's tender body with care.

definition: to get scared; to be filed with fear of impending danger.
example_en: The child got scared by the sound of thunder and started crying.

definition: to become subjected to another; to be a captive; to be caught.
example_en: The soldier became a captive of the enemies in the war.

definition: red fume (as emitted by burning chemicals, etc.).
example_en: Red fume was coming out of the factory chimney.

definition: a soft bed; a mattress.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಮಲಗಲು ಅವಳು ಮೃದುವಾದ ಮೆತ್ತೆಯನ್ನು ಹಾಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She spread a soft mattress to sleep on at night.

definition: region around a village.
example_en: There were green fields in the region around the village.

definition: a heavy stabbing.
example_en: He suffered a severe wound from that heavy stabbing.

definition: a collection of objects or material piled up so as to form a high (usu. conical) mass.
example_en: A heap of paddy lay in the threshing floor.

definition: the place of one's living.
example_en: The soldiers set up a camp dwelling near the forest.

definition: to trip in walking or running; to stumble.
example_en: He tripped on a stone and fell down.

definition: the tree Garcinia xanthochymus (= G. pictoria, = G. tinctoria) of Guttiferae family, with dark bark; Mysore gamboge.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆದ ಕದ್ದಾಳೆ ಮರದಿಂದ ಹಳದಿ ಬಣ್ಣ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: A yellow dye is obtained from the Mysore gamboge tree that grows in the forest.

definition: the rule of a feudal chieftain.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಳೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಶತಮಾನಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Feudal rule continued in that region for centuries.

definition: the plant Crotolaria verrucosa of Papilionaceae family, that grows as a small shrub.
example_en: The Crotolaria verrucosa plant has grown as a shrub in the field.

definition: a heap of dung; a dunghill.
example_en: A big dunghill lay near the cattle shed.

definition: of the nature of coming in and going out.
example: ಆ ಬಂದರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಆಯಾತಪ್ರಯಾತ ಹಡಗುಗಳ ಸಂಚಾರ ಸದಾ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: There is always movement of ships coming in and going out at that port.

definition: a black crab.
example_en: A black crab was hiding among the rocks.

definition: a multitude of enemies.
example: ಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಟ್ಚಕ್ರ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿ ಆಕ್ರಮಣ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: A multitude of enemies gathered at the border and attacked.

definition: to cause to work, toil.
example_en: The master made the workers toil in the field.

definition: a cavity in the bones; sinus.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಎಕ್ಸ್-ರೇಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲುಗುಳಿಯ ಸೋಂಕನ್ನು ಪತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor detected an infection in the bone cavity on the X-ray.

definition: relating to the month Puṣya, the tenth month in the Hindu lunar calendar.
example_en: During the month of Pushya, the cold is intense.

definition: the profession or duty of an unskilled labour.
example_en: He was doing unskilled labour to make a living.

definition: excessive comfort or excessively comfortable life.
example_en: He is living in excessive comfort.

definition: frivolous, mischievous of foolish behavior (of or as of a monkey); monkey business.
example_en: Everyone was annoyed by that boy's monkey business.

definition: a man who stitches (clothes); a tailor.
example_en: The tailor stitched my shirt.

definition: the natural habitat of animals.
example_en: In the middle of the forest was the tiger's natural habitat.

definition: (pl.) two channels on either side of a river.
example_en: There are two channels on either side of the river.

definition: washed with lime; white washed.
example_en: The lime-washed walls were shining in the sunlight.

definition: to communicate through spoken words; to tell; to utter; to say.
example_en: The poet told the meaning of his poem.

definition: being, lying in or toward a place or on a level below another.
example_en: The river water flows toward the place below.

definition: that which is of second grade, quality, etc.
example_en: That rice was of second-grade quality.

definition: a kind of grass.
example_en: A kind of grass had grown thickly at the edge of the forest.

definition: a thought, opinion, idea etc. that is different or of unusual type.
example_en: His is always an unusual, out-of-the-ordinary idea.

definition: a man who a) thieves; a thief; b) deprives the personal property by taking away forcibly; a larcenist; c) kidnaps a person or a child for a ransom; a kidnapper, abductor; d) hijacks an aircraft, bus, etc. for getting his demand met; a hijacker.
example_en: The thief stole the gold necklaces and fled.

definition: a moving of a finger (as a gesture).
example: ಆತ ಬೆರಳಲುಕದಿಂದ ಬಾ ಎಂದು ಸನ್ನೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He gestured to come with a movement of the finger.

definition: the workshop of a goldsmith.
example_en: Gold ornaments are made in that goldsmith's workshop.

definition: a person to whom hospitality is or is to be, exended by another; a guest.
example_en: They gave hospitable welcome to the guest at home.

definition: a term by which warning is given; 'cautioṇ.
example_en: He gave a caution to everyone.

definition: a loose mixture of pebbles and rock fragments coarser than sand, often mixed with clay, etc.; gravel; grit.
example_en: They spread gravel and grit on the footpath and levelled it.

definition: a medicinal substance that causes temporary loss of sensation in a particular part of the body or loss of consciousness; an anaesthetic.
example_en: The doctor gave the patient an anaesthetic injection.

definition: the time in the morning when daylight first appears; dawn.
example: ಹರೆ ಆಗುವ ಮೊದಲೇ ರೈತರು ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊರಟರು.
example_en: The farmers set out for the field even before dawn broke.

definition: the quality of being ferocious; ferociousness.
example_en: The people were frightened seeing the ferociousness of the demon.

definition: one who sells meat; a butcher.
example_en: That butcher sold meat every day.

definition: sweet talk that is capable of winning favour or cheating.
example_en: Everyone was cheated by his sweet, deceptive talk.

definition: (growth or development) to get hindered.
example_en: Without rain, the growth of the crop got hindered.

definition: marked courage; valour; heroism.
example_en: The soldier showed immense valour in the war.

definition: the common behaviour, likings, taste, opinions, etc. of common people.
example_en: The common ways of the people of this town are very simple.

definition: to agree; to consent; to concur.
example_en: Everyone agreed to that proposal.

definition: a mark; a sign.
example_en: They had placed a mark near the temple.

definition: a very young child or infant, esp. one not yet able to walk; a baby.
example_en: That baby is sleeping in the cradle.

definition: a woman belonging to the caste of acrobats.
example: ಆ ದೊಂಬಿತಿ ಹಗ್ಗದ ಮೇಲೆ ನಡೆದು ತೋರಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: That acrobat woman demonstrated by walking on the rope.

definition: the bottom surface of the foot.
example_en: The thorn pricked into the sole of the foot.

definition: Kailāsa, the paradise of Śiva.
example_en: Shiva shines with Parvati in Kailasa, his paradise.

definition: he who wanders, roams; a wanderer.
example_en: That wanderer roams from town to town aimlessly.

definition: moving quickly or whizzingly.
example_en: The kite flew whizzingly across the sky.

definition: that of which a thing consists; physical matter or material; substance.
example_en: This book has good substance.

definition: to measure the length using the distance from the tips of one middle fingers, when both the arms are stratched apart.
example_en: He measured the length of the cloth with his arms.

definition: not cooked properly; half-cooked.
example_en: Since the rice was half-cooked, she cooked it again.

definition: any of a set of hard, bonelike structures set in the jaws of most vertebrates and used for biting, tearing, and chewing: a tooth.
example_en: Grandfather's teeth are now fewer in number.

definition: a gathering of a number persons at a place (as for discussion); an assembly.
example_en: All the people gathered together at the assembly.

definition: the state of being surprised; feeling aroused by something unusual, unexpected, strange or incredible; wonder or astonishment; a surprise.
example: ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಆ ಆಟದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕುತೂಹಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The children's wonder about that game increased.

definition: the fact or condition of being separated or removed in space or time; remoteness; distance.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ಮನೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಗೆಂಟು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was some distance between the two houses.

definition: a male teacher or schoolmaster; a master.
example_en: Our schoolmaster teaches the lesson well.

definition: the heel-bone; calcaneum.
example_en: When he fell, he hurt his heel-bone.

definition: a wheel of a chariot.
example_en: The sculptor carved a chariot wheel on the temple wall.

definition: the act of praising; extolment.
example: ರಾಜನ ಜೇಂಕರವನ್ನು ಕವಿ ತನ್ನ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The poet sang the king's praise in his poem.

definition: the act of giving something (as repayment of a loan amount).
example: ಅವನು ಸಾಲದ ತಿರುಗುಹವನ್ನು ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He made the repayment of the loan on time.

definition: rising; beginning; originating.
example_en: That thought was originating a new change.

definition: a small wooden or metal structure with a depression for the baby's bed, either on rockers or hung to the roof as to swing freely; a cradle.
example_en: The baby is sleeping in the cradle.

definition: a hard try; an attempt; an endeavour; effort.
example: ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಬೆಳೆಸಲು ಆತ ಬಹಳ ಮೇಹನತ್ತು ಪಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: He put in a great deal of effort to grow the business.

definition: a set or combination of two stars.
example: ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಈರರಿಲ್ ಬಹಳ ಪ್ರಕಾಶಮಾನವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That pair of stars was shining very brightly in the sky.

definition: excessiveness; plentifulness.
example_en: This time the harvest has come in plentifulness.

definition: to swear an oath; to utter an execration; to curse.
example_en: The sage grew angry and cursed the king.

definition: not substituted; being original; natural.
example: ಈ ಪಾಠ್ಯಭಾಗ ಅನಾದಿಷ್ಟ, ಮೂಲ ಗ್ರಂಥದಿಂದಲೇ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: This portion of the text is original, it has come from the source text itself.

definition: a religious mendicant, esp. a class of Śaiva ascetics.
example_en: A mendicant ascetic wandered from village to village carrying a small drum.

definition: a small mortar and pestle of metal or stone, used to pound areca nut or to powder medicine.
example_en: Grandmother pounded the areca nut in the small mortar.

definition: today; the present day.
example_en: Today, everyone must attend the meeting.

definition: a man who steals; a thief.
example_en: The police caught the thief.

definition: a developing or being developed.
example_en: She observed the growth of the sapling every day.

definition: the ability to use one's knowledge effectively and readily in execution or performance.
example_en: Her deftness amazed everyone.

definition: a blame; accusation; censure.
example_en: A false accusation was laid upon him.

definition: a limb that is beautiful.
example_en: That dancer's beautiful limb captivated everyone.

definition: caṇḍāla, the lowest caste.
example: ಆ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಲಗುಲ ಜನರನ್ನು ಊರ ಹೊರಗೆ ಇರಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In those days, people of the lowest caste were made to live outside the village.

definition: a kind of small black bird with a long tail.
example_en: The small black bird with the long tail was sitting on the tree branch.

definition: with no basis in fact; without reason.
example_en: He made the accusation without any basis in fact.

definition: a food preparation of the seeds of cacao, roasted, husked, and ground, sweetened and flavoured; a chocolate.
example_en: She brought chocolate for the birthday.

definition: (hist.) a British gold coin valued at 20 shillings or one pound sterling; a sovereign.
example_en: Grandfather gave the sovereign coin to his grandson.

definition: a bitter, taunting, ironical or wounding remark; sarcasm.
example_en: Sarcasm was evident in his words.

definition: inclination or tendency to forgive or pardon; forgiveness.
example: ಗುರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಷ್ಯರ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಕ್ಷಮತೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The teacher had a forgiving inclination toward the students' mistakes.

definition: any of several winglike, membranous organs on the body of a fish, dolphin, etc., used in swimming, turning, and balancing; a fin.
example: ಮೀನಿನ ಈಜುರೆಕ್ಕೆ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ದಿಕ್ಕು ಬದಲಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

definition: a highway way for chariots.
example_en: The chariots sped along the highway.

definition: the plant Phyllanthus lawii of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: Grandmother used the Phyllanthus lawii plant for medicine.

definition: permission, approval or assent; consent.
example_en: One must not go outside without the teacher's permission.

definition: the tree Phyllanthus acidus of Euphorbiaceae family; country star gooseberry tree.
example_en: There is a country star gooseberry tree in the courtyard.

definition: the pointed end of something long and slim; tip.
example_en: The tip of the needle is very sharp.

definition: the sky.
example_en: In the puranas, the sky has been called Vishnupada.

definition: a dishonest, knavish or mischievous man; a scoundrel; a rogue.
example_en: Nobody trusts that scoundrel.

definition: to accept, agree.
example_en: She accepted his proposal.

definition: a dividing or being divided; separation.
example_en: The division of the property was done as per the agreement.

definition: the plant Brassica juncea of Brassicaceae family; mustard plant.
example_en: Mother added the mustard plant to the sambar.

definition: the quality or fact of being perceived by the senses; perceptibility.
example: ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಸುವಾಸನೆಯ ಅವಧಾರ್ಯ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರಲ್ಲೂ ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ.
example_en: The perceptibility of subtle fragrance differs in each person.

definition: the source of light; that which gives forth light.
example_en: The sun itself is the source of light for this world.

definition: that which is desired or wished for; a wish.
example_en: His wish was fulfilled.

definition: the science of planting and taking care of forests; systematic forest management for the production of timber, conservation, etc.; forestry.
example: ವಿಶ್ವವಿದ್ಯಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಅರಣ್ಯ ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಎಂಬ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಕಲಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Forestry science is taught as a subject in the university.

definition: a prescribed rule; an authoritative direction; the act of prescribing a rule; a regulating or regulation; a code.
example_en: Everyone must follow the prescribed rules of the organisation.

definition: a being anxious.
example_en: She felt anxious when the child did not come.

definition: a starting or commencing; a beginning.
example_en: They pray at the beginning of the lesson.

definition: that much or that many as the hand can hold; a handful quantity.
example_en: The farmer took a handful of seeds for sowing.

definition: the place of one's living.
example_en: A poor family was living in that dwelling.

definition: the state being from side to side.
example_en: The fallen tree lay crosswise on the road.

definition: to go or come in; to enter.
example_en: Air enters through the window.

definition: a person who saw or can give a firsthand account of, something; a witness.
example: ಅಪಘಾತವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿದ ಆ ಸಾಕ್ಕಿ ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿದನು.

definition: a man who or that which is revered, respected or worshipped.
example_en: That teacher is revered by everyone.

definition: a going backward; withdrawal.
example_en: The army's withdrawal began at the border.

definition: the plant Asparagus falcatus of Liliaceae family.
example_en: The doctor explained the properties of the shahavali plant.

definition: the short, thick digit of the human hand that is the nearest the one to wrist and is opposable to the other fingers; the thumb.
example_en: His thumb got caught in the door.

definition: an auspicious celebration, occasion or event.
example_en: The whole village had gathered for the wedding celebration.

definition: a sweet dish made of condensed milk.
example_en: Mother made augu (a sweet dish of condensed milk) for the festival.

definition: (pl.) all these persons.
example_en: All these people sat together and ate their meal.

definition: the quality, tendency or fact of being unproductive; unproductivity.
example: ಆ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆಯ ಅನುತ್ಪಾದಕತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಚಿಂತೆ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The unproductivity of that factory worried everyone.

definition: to check, investigate or examine in detail.
example_en: The police examined that case in detail.

definition: to come into sight; to appear; to be seen.
example_en: The mountain peak came into sight in the distance.

definition: to cross over into another's territory.
example_en: The soldiers crossed over into the enemy's territory.

definition: a word formed by affixing a suitable termination or terminations. to a verbal root.
example: 'ಓದುಗ' ಎಂಬ ಪದ 'ಓದು' ಎಂಬ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಪದದಿಂದ ಬಂದ ವ್ಯುತ್ಪನ್ನ ಪದ.
example_en: The word 'ōduga' is a derived word formed from the verb 'ōdu'.

definition: a compassionate, kind woman.
example_en: The compassionate woman always helps the poor.

definition: to cause to hold each otheṛs hands; to cause to marry.
example_en: The priest joined the hands of the bride and groom.

definition: to perceive something by sniffing; to smell.
example: ನಾಯಿ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ವಾಸನೆವಿಡಿದು ಮುಂದೆ ಸಾಗಿತು.
example_en: The dog moved forward smelling the ground.

definition: certainly; surely.
example_en: This is certainly true.

definition: uncombed, disheavelled hair.
example_en: She combed his uncombed hair with a comb after he woke up in the morning.

definition: the act or power of foreseeing; foresight.
example_en: That leader had wonderful foresight.

definition: any bristlelike fiber or fibers, as on the head of barley, oats or wheat; the awn.
example_en: The awn of the wheat ear pricked through the cloth.

definition: that which is related to Indra.
example_en: That mantra was related to Indra.

definition: the end of the world of earth.
example_en: A description of the end of the world appears in the puranas.

definition: a brutal murder; a barbarous slaughter.
example_en: That brutal murder shocked the whole village.

definition: the act of seeing or being seen.
example: ದೇವರ ದೃಷ್ಟ ಪಡೆಯಲು ಭಕ್ತರು ಸಾಲಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: Devotees stood in a line to get a sight of the god.

definition: all that belongs to one, as one's all properties.
example_en: All her properties were burnt in the fire.

definition: the process of surveying a tract of land; survey.
example_en: The engineer came to survey the land.

definition: a tall basket used as a corn-storing bin.
example_en: They filled the corn into the tall storage basket in the granary.

definition: the upper part of the passage leading from the mouth and nose to the stomach and lungs; the throat.
example: ಮೀನಿನ ಮುಳ್ಳು ಗಂಟಲಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿ ಕಡೆಗಳ ನೋವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A fish bone got stuck in the throat and it hurt.

definition: a public meal.
example_en: A public meal was arranged at the fair.

definition: to help another recover peace, calmness.
example_en: The teacher helped the disciple's mind recover its calmness.

definition: a young plant of banana.
example_en: He planted a young banana plant in the yard and watered it.

definition: a mental disorder, typically characterised by a separation between the thought processes and the emotions, a distortion of reality accompanied by delusions and hallucinations, a fragmentation of the personality, motor disturbances, bizarre behaviour, etc., often with no loss of basic intellectual functions; schizophrenia.
example_en: That patient was suffering from schizophrenia.

definition: a lord; a master.
example_en: The master paid the workers' wages today.

definition: to utter a hymn or hymns.
example_en: The priest uttered the hymn during the worship.

definition: to give a kiss to (a person or thing); touch or caress with the lips; to kiss.
example_en: The mother gave the child a loving kiss.

definition: to move one's brow or brows to expresss one's feelings or to convey something.
example_en: He moved his brow to show his displeasure.

definition: a slab of stone for covering a drainage, water passage, etc.
example_en: They placed a covering slab over the drainage.

definition: a narrow place; a strait.
example: ಎರಡು ಗುಡ್ಡಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಕಿರಿದಾದ ಇಟ್ಟಡೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a narrow strait between the two hills.

definition: any of several flesh-eating crocodilians of the genus Crocodylus, having thick, horny skin, long tail, a long, narrow triangular head, large jaws, found in sluggish waters and swamps of the tropics; a crocodile.
example_en: A crocodile was lying on the river bank.

definition: the act of uttering a shrill, piercing cry in pain.
example_en: She let out a shrill piercing cry in pain.

definition: a physically weak man.
example: ಆ ಅಸಳೆ ಭಾರ ಎತ್ತಲು ಆಗದೆ ಕುಸಿದನು.
example_en: That weak man collapsed, unable to lift the load.

definition: deep trouble; great loss and sorrow; disaster; calamity.
example_en: The flood brought disaster to the village.

definition: the lustre of the eye.
example_en: The lustre of her eyes drew everyone's attention.

definition: to come in front of or face to face with.
example_en: They confronted the enemy army face to face.

definition: the fact of (a person or thing) belonging to another place, country.
example_en: He felt like an outsider in the new town.

definition: a sore on the body of a bedridden person, caused by body-pressure; a bed-sore.
example_en: A bed-sore appeared on the old woman's back.

definition: the room or hall in front of the sanctum santorum of a temple.
example_en: The priest stood in the hall before the sanctum and chanted mantras.

definition: to unite, join two or more things together.
example_en: The carpenter joined the two planks together.

definition: an irrepressible desire.
example_en: She had an irrepressible desire to build a house.

definition: to wash with water to separate fine particles from the coarser ones.
example: ಅಕ್ಕಿಯನ್ನು ನೀರಿನಿಂದ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಜಾಲಿಸಿ ಕಸ ತೆಗೆದಳು.
example_en: She washed the rice well with water and removed the impurities.

definition: to antagonise - a) to oppose or counteract; b) to incur the dislike of; to make an enemy of.
example_en: He lived peacefully without antagonising anyone.

definition: a wrong statement; a deceiving speech; act of lying; concealment of facts.
example_en: There was a deceiving concealment of truth in his words.

definition: the act and process of cooking food.
example_en: Today's cooking was tasty.

definition: to have (something) to get.
example_en: He still has a debt to get.

definition: a prolonged or serious shortage or deficiency, caused by a prolonged period of dry weather; drought; famine.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಢಾವರ ಇಡೀ ಜನಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಬಾಧಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The drought afflicted the entire life of the people in that region.

definition: an incarnation of Śiva.
example_en: People worship Khandoba as an incarnation of Shiva.

definition: a long shaft with a pointed end used for piercing; a spear.
example_en: The guard held a spear in his hand.

definition: a woman given to bragging or boasting much.
example: ಆ ಮಠಾರಿ ತನ್ನ ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬಡಾಯಿ ಕೊಚ್ಚಿಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: That boastful woman bragged about her wealth.

definition: a beautiful woman.
example: ಆ ಇಳಲೆಯ ಸೊಬಗು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The beauty of that lovely woman captivated everyone's mind.

definition: the annual herb Lycopersicum esculentum of Solanaceae family.
example_en: The farmer planted tomato plants in the garden.

definition: in this manner, way, type, fashion etc.
example_en: If done in this manner, the work will finish quickly.

definition: the cavity formed by open hands joined together and folded slightly; the hollow of the palms.
example_en: The boy filled the hollow of his palms with water.

definition: the fact of being entangled in the cycle of life and deaths; a being reborn repeatedly.
example_en: Because of being entangled in the cycle of life and deaths, he is being reborn again and again.

definition: (gen.) a blossom of a plant; a flower.
example_en: A beautiful flower blossomed on the creeper.

definition: to move, wander, fly from one place to another (as a bumble bee).
example_en: The bumble bee flew wandering from flower to flower.

definition: unpleasant or uneasy feeling in the mind, caused by anxiety, fear, disappointment, etc.
example: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲಮಲ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: He felt uneasy in his mind about the exam result.

definition: to utter along, shrill sound as from pain.
example_en: The boy uttered a shrill sound from the pain.

definition: a pressing or squeezing.
example: ಕಬ್ಬಿನ ರಸ ತೆಗೆಯಲು ಬಲವಾದ ಪೀಡನ ಬೇಕು.
example_en: A strong pressing is needed to extract the juice of sugarcane.

definition: the frame of a door; a door-frame.
example_en: The house's door-frame had become old and worn out.

definition: to cause to sink; to press or push another under a liquid.
example_en: He pushed his enemy under the water.
